operation.name: ED50 to WGS 84 (18)
operation.why: Same North Sea ED50 to WGS 84 operation as for geographic ED50; UTM zone 31N inverted to ED50 first

assumptions: Inverse UTM zone 31N on ED50 (EPSG:23031 to EPSG:4230), then EPSG:1311.
notes: PROJ default for 23031->4326 picks ED50 to WGS 84 (1) (about 1 m different); EPSG:1311 chosen deliberately for North Sea accuracy.
